All six registers can now be bulk-edited through their own modules. The four required tests pass, and every acceptance check exits 0 in its final run. Changes are left uncommitted.

**One thing to decide at merge: two wiring lines outside my file list.** `forms/bulk.ts` can't import the six update functions directly. The module rules enforced in `architecture.test.ts` don't let forms depend on raid, governance, portfolio, adoption or benefits. They also say no P5 module may import `workflows`, which is where T04 design decisions live. Changing those rules would be a contract change, so I didn't. Instead:
- Each module exports its single-record update function (the core of its PATCH route) through its `index.ts`, with BE-E2's signature.
- `forms/bulk.ts` holds the bulk map, one line per register (T04, T05, T13, T14, T15, T16). If the map is not filled, those fields still get the existing 422 refusal.
- The two extra lines fill that map: one `setFormBulkUpdaters({...})` call in `server.ts`, and its export from `forms/index.ts`. This is the same pattern the orchestrator used for `setMeetingPackAssembler` in D-159. Please accept them or redo them.
- I also had to add `updateDesignDecision` to the export list that `workflows.test.ts` checks (2 lines).
- "Decisions (T04/T16)" are two modules, `workflows` and `governance`, so six `index.ts` files carry an export, not five.

**Single-record PATCH routes behave as before.** Each one still reads If-Match at the same point, so refusals come in the same order. Every DG2–DG4 suite of these modules passes in the full integration run.

**Tests** (new file `apps/api/test/integration/forms/form-bulk-registers.test.ts`, 21 tests, real PostgreSQL):
- **Owners on 3 T15 records:** all saved, one `raid_entry.update` audit event each, every version up by one.
- **One stale version among the 3:** 409 `form_record.bulk_conflict` listing only that record. Nothing is written and no audit event is recorded.
- **The same two tests** for one field each of T04, T16, T05, T13 and T14.
- **Extra checks:**
  - AUD gets 403 on all six registers.
  - T16's own owner rule still applies: one bad item rolls back the whole request.
  - A T16 record sent to the T04 bulk edit gets 404.
  - Fields not marked bulk-editable are still refused.
- **Mutation check:** with the bulk map switched off, 14 of the 21 tests fail. The other 7 (six AUD 403s and the non-editable field) should pass either way.
- **BE-E2's T15-refusal assertion is removed** from `form-records.test.ts`, as the assignment asks.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4` | exit 0 at start and end |
| typecheck, build, lint, prettier, openapi:lint | all exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | exit 0: 2120 / 1429 / 259 + 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset (final run) | exit 0: same counts |
| `pnpm test:integration` | exit 0: 2557 passed + 1 skipped. That is +21 over D-159's 2536 + 1, exactly the new file. |

Two earlier locale-unset runs failed:
- **Run 1, my fault, fixed:** the `workflows.test.ts` export list didn't include `updateDesignDecision` yet.
- **Run 2, not this task's code:** `packages/reporting/src/pdf/pdf.test.ts` timed out at vitest's 5 s default while the machine's load average was about 18. That package is untouched here, and the file passes 13/13 on its own. Giving it an explicit timeout is optional; it belongs to BE-N.

**Other items:**
- There's nothing to move from a pending list: no new operation, no contract-count change, no migration, no new dependency.
- No user-facing text became untrue.
- Untracked dotfiles and `CLAUDE.local.md` at the repo root aren't mine.
